pages.text: Mandrake is never a polite harvest. In the older craft, a mature root sometimes comes quietly and sometimes wakes as a shrieking creature instead, especially at night and under harsher conditions.$(br2)Witchery: Rewoven now restores that split more honestly: when the crop does awaken, the living root keeps nearby players sickened until it is killed.

Craft $(item)Earmuffs$() from leather and white wool before gathering a large Mandrake patch. Wearing them in the head slot blocks the restored nausea scream, which makes repeated harvests far less miserable.$(br2)They also blunt the first practical Banshee scream damage again and now mute world sounds on the client while worn, matching the old deafening protection much more closely.

pages.title: What Still Remains
pages.text: The current port is strongest on the crop's summon-vs-drop branch and on the first practical protection loop: grow the crop, expect the scream, and wear Earmuffs if you plan to farm roots in quantity.$(br2)Exact Mandrake scream audio flavor and broader in-game sound feel still need QA, but the protective item path is now live.
